leads.title: Mongolian Constitution, Article 16 (11)
leads.documents: Defines marriage as based on equality and mutual consent of a man and a woman; basis for non-recognition of same-sex relationships
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 16 (11) of the Mongolian Constitution' - no URL visible

leads.title: Mongolian Penal Code, Section 14.1.1
leads.documents: Bans all discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity, in effect since 2017
leads.detail: Cited as 'Section 14.1.1 of the Penal Code, in effect since 2017' - no URL visible

leads.title: Mongolian Criminal Code, Section 10(1)(2)(14) - New Criminal Code adopted 3 December 2015
leads.documents: Aggravates penalties for homicides motivated by hate towards victim's sexual orientation and gender identity; adoption made Mongolia one of first Asian countries with this level of protection
leads.detail: Cited as adoption on '3 December 2015' by 'Mongolian Parliament', planned force 1 Sept 2016 postponed to 1 July 2017 - no URL visible

leads.title: Mongolian Labor Code, Article 6 (2022)
leads.documents: Bans discrimination based on sexual orientation, gender identity, and gender expression in employment
leads.detail: Cited as 'Since 2022, Article 6 of the Labor Code' - no URL visible

leads.title: Civil Registration Law, Article 20(1) amendment June 2009
leads.documents: Allows transgender people to change legal gender on birth certificates or citizen ID cards following sex reassignment surgery; related hate-speech / hate-crime protections for gender identity
leads.detail: Cited as 'Amendment made in June 2009 to Article 20(1)' Mongolian: Улсын бүртгэлийн ерөнхий хууль - no URL visible

leads.title: LGBT Centre - 2019 report
leads.documents: Documents living conditions: 79% of LGBTQ-identified young people in Mongolia experienced bullying, discrimination and/or ostracism
leads.detail: Cited as 'A 2019 report from the LGBT Centre' - no URL or full title visible

leads.title: LGBT Centre - 2013 report
leads.documents: Documents over 73% of LGBTQ Mongolians had considered suicide due to social nonacceptance and intolerance
leads.detail: Cited as 'A 2013 report by the LGBT Centre' - no URL or full title visible

leads.title: Documented anti-LGBTQ violence cases 2001, 2009, February 2014
leads.documents: 2001 lesbian woman raped, abducted and stabbed by two men; 2009 ultra-nationalist neo-Nazi group kidnapped three transgender women and sexually assaulted them; Feb 2014 gay man sexually assaulted by neo-Nazi group; none of early crimes reported for fear of victimization
leads.detail: Incident leads described without outlet citation in text; notes police disregard complaints and attacks often result in no punishment - no URL visible

leads.title: Government of Mongolia enforcement machinery - May 2014 announcement and August 2018 training
leads.documents: Government announced May 2014 it would consider anti-discrimination legislation after public outcry; as of Aug 2018 LGBT Centre training 300+ police officers, prosecutors and judges on hate crimes handling
leads.detail: Cited as Government announcement May 2014 and LGBT Centre training figure - no URL visible

leads.title: Official website of the LGBT Centre (in Mongolian) / Mongolia - GlobalGayz
leads.documents: LGBT Centre mandate: advocacy for human rights of lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender people; sole NGO registered 2009 after 10+ attempts; organizer of Equality and Pride Days; GlobalGayz country page for Mongolia
leads.detail: Listed under External links as 'Official website of the LGBT Centre' and 'Mongolia. GlobalGayz.' - no URLs visible in text
